affine.description: An affine transform as six numbers `[a, b, c, d, e, f]`: a point (x, y) maps to (a*x + c*y + e, b*x + d*y + f). `[1,0,0,1,0,0]` is the identity.

anchor.description: One anchor point of a path.

in.description: The incoming Bezier handle `[x, y]`, an absolute position (the second control point of the segment that ends at this anchor). Absent: equal to `p` (no handle: that end of the segment is straight).

kind.description: How an editor moves the handles; it does not change the curve. One of: `Corner` (the handles move independently; the default when absent); `Smooth` (the handles stay collinear through `p`).

out.description: The outgoing Bezier handle `[x, y]`, an absolute position (the first control point of the segment that starts at this anchor). Absent: equal to `p`.

appearance.description: How an object is painted: a stack of fills and strokes, and effects on the whole object.

contents_index.description: Groups, layers and type only: how many of `items` paint BELOW the object's contents (its members, or the characters of type); the rest paint above. Absent: every item paints above the contents.

effects.description: Live effects applied to the object as a whole, in order. Absent: none.

items.description: The fills and strokes, bottom first: each paints over the ones before it. Absent: none (the object paints nothing of its own).

appearance_item.description: One fill or stroke of an appearance.

area_fit.description: How an area type frame and its text fit each other. One of: `"none"` (the frame keeps its size; text that does not fit overflows), `"autoHeight"` (the frame's height follows the text), or `{"shrinkText": {"minPercent": n}}` (text that overflows is scaled down, to no less than n percent, until it fits).

minPercent.description: The smallest scale, in percent. Absent: 50.

firstBaseline.description: Where the first line's baseline sits below the frame's top. One of: `ascent` (the tallest glyph touches the top; the default); `capHeight` (capitals touch the top); `xHeight` (the x-height touches the top); `leading` (one leading below the top); `fixed` (exactly `firstBaselineMin` below the top).

firstBaselineMin.description: Smallest offset of the first baseline, in points. Absent: 0.

fit.description: Auto size or shrink to fit. Absent: none.

gutter.description: Space between rows and between columns, in points. Absent: 18.

inset.description: Inset of the text from the frame's edges, in points. Absent: 0.

rows.description: Number of rows the frame is divided into. Absent: 1.

verticalAlign.description: Vertical alignment of the lines in each row or column. One of: `top` (from the top; the default); `center` (centred); `bottom` (the last line's descent touches the bottom); `justify` (first line at the top, last at the bottom, the space shared between lines).

arrowhead.description: The shape of an arrowhead, by name; the shape is drawn by the reader (a reader that has no drawing for a name draws none). `...Open` is the outlined form of a shape; `HalfArrowLeft` / `HalfArrowRight` have one barb, on the left / right of the direction the head points. One of: `Triangle`, `TriangleOpen`, `Circle`, `CircleOpen`, `Square`, `SquareOpen`, `Bar`, `Diamond`, `Arrow`, `ArrowOpen`, `Barbed`, `HalfArrowLeft`, `HalfArrowRight`, `Concave`, `DoubleBar`, `Feather`, `DotOnBar`, `Chevron`, `DoubleArrow`, `Target`, `Star`, `Cross`, `Plus`, `Hexagon`, `HexagonOpen`, `Tag`, `TagOpen`, `HalfCircle`, `Drop`, `Slash`, `DoubleSlash`, `DiamondOpen`, `TriangleReverse`, `Swallowtail`, `Bracket`, `Fork`, `Leaf`, `Kite`, `TriangleBar`, `Oval`.

attrs.description: Attributes of an object that do not change how it prints.

data.description: The object's own data, in order: SVG `data-*` attributes (`data-pivot="100,180"` is `["pivot", "100,180"]`). Absent: none.

imageMap.description: The clickable area `url` covers in web output. One of: `none` (none; the default); `rectangle` (the object's bounding box); `polygon` (the object's outline).

showCenter.description: Whether an editor shows the object's centre point. Absent: the object kind's default.

url.description: The URL the object links to in web output (SVG `<a href>`). Absent: none.

blend_mode.description: How the painted colour (source) combines with what is below it (backdrop), per colour channel on values 0 to 1, as the separable and non-separable blend modes of PDF 1.4 / W3C Compositing and Blending Level 1 define them. One of: `Normal` (result = source; the default when absent); `Darken` (min(backdrop, source) per channel); `Multiply` (backdrop * source); `ColorBurn` (1 - min(1, (1 - backdrop) / source), 0 where source is 0); `Lighten` (max(backdrop, source)); `Screen` (backdrop + source - backdrop * source); `ColorDodge` (min(1, backdrop / (1 - source)), 1 where source is 1); `Overlay` (HardLight with backdrop and source swapped); `SoftLight` (the W3C compositing soft-light formula); `HardLight` (Multiply(backdrop, 2*source) where source <= 0.5, else Screen(backdrop, 2*source - 1)); `Difference` (|backdrop - source|); `Exclusion` (backdrop + source - 2 * backdrop * source); `Hue` (hue of the source, saturation and luminosity of the backdrop); `Saturation` (saturation of the source, hue and luminosity of the backdrop); `Color` (hue and saturation of the source, luminosity of the backdrop); `Luminosity` (luminosity of the source, hue and saturation of the backdrop).

keyAnchors.description: For each key object, the anchor of the spine's first contour it sits on. Absent: the key objects are spread evenly along the spine.

orientation.description: How the steps are oriented. One of: `alignToPage` (upright; the default); `alignToPath` (turned to follow the spine).

spacing.description: How many steps lie between each pair of key objects: `"smoothColor"` (chosen from the colour difference; the default), `{"steps": n}` (n steps, 1 to 1000) or `{"distance": d}` (a step every d points).

spine.description: The path the steps are placed along. Absent: straight lines between the key objects' centres.

starts.description: For each key object, the anchor of its first contour the blend starts from, or null (chosen so closed shapes do not twist). Absent: all null.

char_position.description: Whether characters are set as superscript or subscript.

kind.description: The position. One of: `normal` (on the baseline); `superscript` (raised and reduced by `size` and `position`); `subscript` (lowered and reduced by `size` and `position`).

position.description: superscript and subscript only: baseline offset in percent of the font size.

size.description: superscript and subscript only: glyph size in percent of the font size.

char_style.description: The character attributes of a run of type.

all_caps.description: Drawn in capitals whatever was typed. Absent: false.

baseline_shift.description: Raise (positive) of the characters above the baseline, in points. Absent: 0.

charAlign.description: Where characters smaller than the largest on their line align with it. One of: `romanBaseline` (on the roman baseline; the default when absent); `emBoxTop` (top of the em box); `emBoxCenter` (centre of the em box); `emBoxBottom` (bottom of the em box); `icfTop` (top of the ideographic character face); `icfBottom` (bottom of the ideographic character face).

digits.description: The numeral system digits are drawn in, whatever digits were typed. One of: `default` (as typed; the default when absent); `arabic` (Western digits 0-9); `hindi` (Arabic-Indic digits U+0660-U+0669); `farsi` (Eastern Arabic-Indic digits U+06F0-U+06F9).

features.description: OpenType features that differ from the font's defaults. Absent: none.

items.description: An OpenType feature tag; a leading `-` turns the feature off (`dlig` on, `-liga` off).

fill.description: What the characters are filled with.

font_family.description: The font's typographic family name (for example `Source Sans 3`). The font file itself, when it could be embedded, is listed in the x.vectorcraft.embedded node.

font_style.description: The font's style name within the family (for example `Regular`, `Bold Italic`). Absent: `Regular`.

font_version.description: The font's version string (name table id 5) when several versions of the family and style may be installed. Absent: whichever version the family and style pick.

h_scale.description: Horizontal scale of the glyphs in percent. Absent: 100.

kerning.description: Manual kerning before this run's characters, in 1/1000 em. Absent: the font's own kerning.

leading.description: Line spacing in points. Absent: automatic, 120% of `size`.

overprint_fill.description: Overprint the fill of these characters. Absent: false.

overprint_stroke.description: Overprint the stroke of these characters. Absent: false.

proportionalMetrics.description: True: full-width East Asian glyphs take the font's proportional widths (OpenType `palt`; `vpal` in vertical type). Absent: false.

rotation.description: Rotation of each character about its own origin, in degrees, counter-clockwise as seen on screen. Absent: 0.

small_caps.description: Small capitals: lowercase letters are drawn as capitals at this percentage of the size. Absent: off.

stroke.description: What the characters' outlines are stroked with. Absent: none.

stroke_cap.description: The shape of the stroke's open ends. One of: `Butt` (cut square at the end point; the default when absent); `Round` (a semicircle of diameter `width`); `Square` (a square extending half the width past the end point).

stroke_dash.description: Dash pattern of the character stroke. Absent: solid.

stroke_join.description: The shape of the stroke's corners. One of: `Miter` (extended to a point while within `miter_limit`, else bevelled; the default when absent); `Round` (rounded with radius half the width); `Bevel` (cut straight across).

stroke_miter_limit.description: Miter limit of the character stroke. Absent: 10.

stroke_width.description: Width of the character stroke in points. Absent: 0.

style_name.description: Name of the character style (in the core.text.styles node) these attributes come from. Absent: the normal character style.

tracking.description: Extra spacing after every character, in 1/1000 em. Absent: 0.

v_scale.description: Vertical scale of the glyphs in percent. Absent: 100.

color.description: A colour. Components are IEEE 754 binary32 values written in decimal.

model.description: The colour model. One of: `rgb` (red, green, blue); `cmyk` (cyan, magenta, yellow, black inks); `gray` (black ink only); `lab` (CIE L*a*b*).

color_cmyk.description: A CMYK colour: ink amounts in the document's CMYK space.

color_gray.description: A gray: an amount of black ink.

color_lab.description: A CIE L*a*b* colour, D50 white point (device independent; how spot colours are defined).

color_rgb.description: An RGB colour (sRGB unless the document names another RGB profile).

corner_kind.description: The shape of a live corner. One of: `round` (a quarter circle bulging outwards; the default); `invertedRound` (a quarter circle cut into the shape); `chamfer` (a straight bevel).

align_corners.description: True: dashes are adjusted in length so that they sit on corners and path ends. Absent: false.

offset.description: Distance into the pattern at which the stroke starts, in points. Absent: 0.

pattern.description: Dash, gap, dash, gap ... lengths in points, repeated along the stroke.

effect.description: A live effect: a named operation applied to the art when it is drawn, leaving the object's own geometry unchanged. The vocabulary of ids is open: a reader draws the object WITHOUT an effect whose id it does not implement and keeps the effect when it writes the object back. `spec/examples/vector-art/effects.md` lists the ids VectorCraft writes.

params.description: The effect's parameters: a JSON value whose members the effect id defines. Absent: null.

visible.description: False: the effect is kept but not applied. Absent: true.

envelope_kind.description: What an envelope distorts its content with.

type.description: The kind of envelope. One of: `warp` (a preset warp); `mesh` (a mesh); `topObject` (the outline of a path).

envelope_mesh.description: A mesh the content's bounding box is mapped onto.

handles.description: Bezier handles of each point, in the order of `points`. Absent: a smooth (Catmull-Rom) mesh through the points.

items.description: The four handles of one point, as offsets from it: towards the next column, the previous column, the next row, the previous row.

points.description: The (rows+1) x (cols+1) mesh points, row by row.

antiAlias.description: Smooth rasters when they are distorted. Absent: true.

distortAppearance.description: True: strokes and effects are applied before the distortion and bend with the art. Absent: true.

distortLinearGradients.description: With distortAppearance: gradients bend with the art. Absent: false.

distortPatternFills.description: With distortAppearance: pattern tiles bend with the art. Absent: false.

preserveShape.description: How distorted rasters keep their shape. One of: `clippingMask` (a clipping mask; the default); `transparency` (an alpha channel).

envelope_top.description: The content's bounding box is mapped onto the outline of a path.

bend.description: Amount of bend, -100 to 100 percent. Absent: 0.

horizontal.description: True: the bend is applied along the horizontal axis; false: along the vertical. Absent: true.

style.description: The warp's name. VectorCraft writes one of: arc, arcLower, arcUpper, arch, bulge, shellLower, shellUpper, flag, wave, fish, rise, fisheye, inflate, squeeze, twist.

fill_item.description: A fill: the object's shape painted.

blend.description: Blend mode of this fill or stroke alone. Absent: `Normal`.

effects.description: Live effects applied to this fill or stroke alone, in order. Absent: none.

opacity.description: Opacity of this fill or stroke alone, 0 to 1. Absent: 1.

overprint.description: True: on press, the inks of this fill or stroke print over the inks below instead of knocking them out. Absent: false.

paint.description: What the fill is painted with.

visible.description: False: kept but not painted. Absent: true.

fill_rule.description: Which regions of self-overlapping contours are inside. One of: `NonZero` (the non-zero winding rule; the default when absent); `EvenOdd` (the even-odd rule).

freeform.description: The points of a freeform gradient.

items.description: One line: a smooth curve through these points, in order.

mode.description: How the editor's Gradient tool adds points; it does not change the colours. One of: `points` (single points; the default when absent); `lines` (points joined into lines).

freeform_point.description: One colour point of a freeform gradient.

at.description: The point's position (document coordinates; text space for a run of type).

opacity.description: Opacity at the point, 0 to 1. Absent: 1.

spread.description: Radius of the disc of pure colour around the point, 0 to 1 of the gradient's spread scale. Absent: 0.25.

gradient.description: A gradient: its kind and colour stops.

kind.description: The gradient's geometry. One of: `Linear` (colours change along the line from `geom.start` to `geom.end`); `Radial` (colours change with distance from the centre `geom.start` out to `geom.end`); `Freeform` (colours spread from the points and lines of `freeform`).

gradient_geom.description: Where a gradient lies, in document coordinates (text space for a run of type).

aspect.description: Radial only: the ellipse's height over its width, measured across and along the `start`-`end` direction. Absent: 1 (a circle).

end.description: Linear: where offset 1 is. Radial: a point on the outer edge (offset 1).

focal.description: Radial only: where offset 0 sits when it is not the centre (inside the ellipse). Absent: the centre.

start.description: Linear: where offset 0 is. Radial: the centre.

gradient_stop.description: One colour stop of a gradient.

color.description: The stop's colour. With `swatch`, the linked swatch's colour at `tint`.

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the two colours mix half and half: 0.13 to 0.87 of the way. Absent: 0.5 (a linear ramp).

offset.description: Where the stop sits along the gradient: 0 (start) to 1 (end).

swatch.description: Name of the global or spot swatch (in the swatches node) this stop's colour is linked to. Absent: not linked.

tint.description: Tint of the linked swatch, 0 to 1. Absent: 1.

inline_art.description: An inline graphic: the run is one U+FFFC character drawn as a symbol that flows with the text like a glyph.

baseline_shift.description: Extra raise in points (positive is up). Absent: 0.

scale.description: Height of the art as a multiple of the run's font size. Absent: 1.

symbol.description: Name of the symbol drawn (the `name` in a core.vector.symbol node).

json.description: Any JSON value, carried verbatim. Strings inside it are never references to other parts of the document.

kind_blend.description: A live blend: the key objects, between which a reader interpolates intermediate steps (shape and paint).

kind_compound.description: A compound path: its members are paths painted as ONE shape with the compound's own appearance (overlaps make holes by `rule`).

children.description: The members, bottom first: each paints over the ones before it.

kind_envelope.description: A live envelope distortion of its content.

content.description: The art distorted, undistorted, bottom first.

editing.description: True: an editor is editing the content rather than the envelope. Absent: false.

fidelity.description: How closely the distorted art follows the envelope, 0 to 100. Absent: 50.

frame.description: The envelope's own axes mapped into the document (rotation, shear or reflection it took since it was made). Absent: the identity.

kind_group.description: A group. With `clip`, a clip group.

children.description: The members, bottom first: each paints over the ones before it.

clip.description: True: the first (bottom-most) member is the clipping path: the others show only inside its outline. Absent: false.

height.description: Height of the image in pixels.

key.description: The image's key: the structure node's `images` table maps it to the core.vector.image node holding its pixels. A key the table does not have draws nothing.

link.description: The file a linked image shows. Absent or null: an embedded image.

width.description: Width of the image in pixels.

xf.description: Maps pixel space (0,0) to (width,height), origin at the image's top-left corner, into the document.

kind_layer.description: A layer or sublayer: a named container.

children.description: The members, bottom first: each paints over the ones before it.

clip.description: True: the first (bottom-most) member is a clipping path for the others. Absent: false.

dim_images.description: An editor shows images on the layer faded to this percentage. Absent or null: not dimmed.

preview.description: False: an editor shows the layer's art in outline. Absent: true.

printable.description: False: the layer is not printed or exported. Absent: true.

template.description: True: a template layer (shown dimmed, never printed). Absent: false.

kind_mesh.description: A gradient mesh: a grid of coloured points; colour is interpolated smoothly across each patch.

points.description: The (rows+1) x (cols+1) points, row by row.

kind_path.description: A path: geometry painted by the object's appearance.

clipping.description: True: this path acts as the clipping path of the clip group it is in. Absent: false.

guide.description: True: a guide path (shown in an editor, never printed). Absent: false.

live.description: The shape the path was generated from. Absent: a plain path.

kind_placeddocument.description: A placed document: one artboard of another document, shown as one locked object. Its pixels (a preview rendering) are in the core.vector.image node the structure node's `images` table gives for `key`; the placed file itself, when the application had it, is in an x.vectorcraft.source.vectorcraft node (see the x.vectorcraft.embedded node).

bounding.description: True: the box is the bounds of the placed art rather than its artboard. Absent: false.

height.description: Height of the box at 100%, in points.

key.description: The key of the placed file in the structure node's `images` table.

link.description: Where the placed file came from (`page`: the artboard shown, 1-based).

width.description: Width of the box at 100%, in points.

xf.description: Maps the box (0,0) to (width,height) into the document.

kind_repeat.description: A live repeat: its source art drawn several times.

kind_symbolinstance.description: An instance of a symbol: the symbol's art drawn through a transform.

symbol.description: Name of the symbol (the `name` in a core.vector.symbol node; the structure node's `symbols` table says which node). A name the document does not have draws nothing.

xf.description: Maps the symbol's coordinates into the document.

kind.description: Point type, area type or type on a path.

para.description: The attributes of every paragraph, unless `paras` gives each its own. Absent: all defaults.

paras.description: Per-paragraph attributes, one entry per paragraph in order. Absent: every paragraph uses `para`.

pathAlign.description: Type on a path: which line of the font sits on the path. One of: `baseline` (the baseline; the default); `ascender` (the font's top edge); `descender` (the font's bottom edge); `center` (halfway between).

pathEffect.description: Type on a path: how glyphs are oriented. One of: `rainbow` (glyphs rotate with the path; the default); `skew` (vertical edges stay vertical); `3dRibbon` (horizontal edges stay horizontal); `stairStep` (no rotation: each glyph's baseline start sits on the path); `gravity` (glyphs point away from the path's centre).

pathSpacing.description: Type on a path: glyphs are spaced as if set this many points above the path. Absent: 0.

runs.description: The text, as runs of uniformly styled characters, in reading order.

vertical.description: True: lines run top to bottom and follow each other right to left. Absent: false.

wrap.description: The shapes this area type flows around. Absent: none.

xf.description: Maps text space into the document. Point type: the origin of text space is the start of the first baseline.

layer_color.description: The colour an editor uses for a layer's selection outlines: `{"Preset": n}`, the n-th colour of the application's fixed list, or `{"Custom": [r, g, b]}` with components 0 to 255.

Preset.description: Index into the application's list of layer colours.

link.description: Where a placed file came from. The file's content is embedded in this package (the structure node's `images` table and the x.vectorcraft.embedded node); these fields are a record of its origin and are never followed by a reader of this package.

hash.description: VectorCraft's own fingerprint of the file's bytes when last read (`img` then 16 hex digits of a 64-bit FNV-1a hash).

modified.description: The file's modification time when it was last read, in milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

page.description: For a linked document: the page (artboard) shown, 1-based.

path.description: The absolute path the file had on the computer where it was placed.

relative.description: That path relative to the folder the document was saved in, with `/` separators.

size.description: The file's size when it was last read, in bytes.

pie.description: Pie start and end angles in degrees; `[0, 360]` is the full ellipse.

xf.description: Maps the untransformed ellipse (origin at the top-left corner of its box) into the document.

live_path.description: Any other path whose corners were cut: it keeps its uncut outline so the corners stay editable.

base.description: The path with its corners uncut, in document coordinates.

kinds.description: Corner shapes, in the same order. Absent: round.

radii.description: Corner radii by anchor index of `base`, counting every contour's anchors in order. Absent: sharp.

kinds.description: Corner shapes, in the order of `radii`. Absent: round.

radii.description: Corner radii by vertex. Absent: sharp.

radius.description: Distance from the centre to each vertex, in points.

xf.description: Maps the untransformed polygon (centred on the origin) into the document.

kinds.description: Corner shapes, in the order of `radii`. Absent: all round.

radii.description: Corner radii: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.

xf.description: Maps the untransformed rectangle (origin at its top-left corner) into the document.

live_shape.description: The parameters a path was generated from (a shape drawn with a shape tool), kept so the shape stays editable as a shape. The object's `path` already holds the resulting outline: a reader that only draws may ignore this.

shape.description: The kind of shape. One of: `rectangle` (a rectangle with corner radii); `ellipse` (an ellipse or pie); `polygon` (a regular polygon); `line` (a line segment); `path` (a path with live corners).

mask.description: An opacity mask: the luminance of the mask art scales the object's opacity (white shows the object, black hides it).

art.description: The mask art, in document coordinates.

clip.description: True: outside the mask art the object is hidden; false: outside it the object stays visible. Absent: true.

disabled.description: True: the mask is kept but not applied. Absent: false.

invert.description: True: the mask's luminance is inverted. Absent: false.

linked.description: True: the mask moves with the object. Absent: true.

mesh_point.description: One point of a gradient mesh.

handles.description: Tangent handles as offsets from `p`: towards the next column, the previous column, the next row, the previous row. Absent: all zero.

opacity.description: Opacity at the point, 0 to 1. Absent: 1.

object.description: One object of the document: a layer, a group, a path, type, an image ... Objects form a tree; an object's position among its siblings is its paint order (first is bottom).

appearance.description: How the object is painted. Absent: nothing of its own (containers paint their members).

bbox_angle.description: The angle of the object's own axes, in degrees, counter-clockwise as seen on screen (its bounding box and handles stand at this angle in an editor). Absent: 0.

blend.description: How the object as a whole blends with what is below. Absent: `Normal`.

graphic_style.description: The `id` of the graphic style (in the core.vector.styles node) last applied to the object and still matching it. Absent or null: none.

id.description: The object's id: an unsigned 64-bit integer, unique among the objects of the document's layers and never reused. Other parts of the document name an object by it. Read it as an integer, not as a binary64.

isolate.description: True: blend modes inside the object do not reach below the object (an isolated transparency group). Absent: false.

knockout.description: Containers: whether the members knock each other out (each shows the backdrop of the group, not the members below it). One of: `neutral` (as the enclosing group says; the default); `on` (they do); `off` (they do not).

knockout_shape.description: True: inside a knockout group, the object's opacity and opacity mask scale how much it knocks out. Absent: false.

locked.description: True: an editor does not let the object be selected or changed. Absent: false.

mask.description: An opacity mask. Absent or null: none.

name.description: The object's name as the user gave it. Absent or null: unnamed.

opacity.description: Opacity of the object as a whole, 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque), applied to the composite of everything it paints. Absent: 1.

visible.description: False: hidden (not drawn, not printed). Absent: true.

wrap.description: Text wrap: area type below this object flows around it. Absent or null: none.

object_kind.description: What an object is, with the data of that kind. A reader that meets a `type` it does not know draws nothing for the object and keeps it.

type.description: The kind of object. One of: `layer` (a layer or sublayer); `group` (a group or clip group); `path` (a path); `compound` (a compound path); `text` (type); `image` (a raster image); `symbolinstance` (an instance of a symbol); `blend` (a live blend); `envelope` (a live envelope distortion); `mesh` (a gradient mesh); `repeat` (a live repeat); `placeddocument` (a placed document).

paint.description: A paint: what a fill, a stroke or a run of type is painted with.

type.description: The kind of paint. One of: `none` (nothing); `solid` (a flat colour); `gradient` (a gradient); `pattern` (a repeated pattern tile).

angle.description: Direction of an unplaced gradient (no `geom`), in degrees, counter-clockwise as seen on screen from the positive x axis. Absent: 0.

freeform.description: The points of a `Freeform` gradient, in the space of `geom`. Absent: placed automatically on the object's box, coloured along the stops.

geom.description: Where the gradient lies. Absent: fitted to the painted object's bounding box each time it is drawn, at `angle`: a linear gradient spans the box through its centre; a radial one is centred with radius half the box's larger side.

swatch.description: Name of the gradient swatch the paint is linked to. Absent: not linked.

paint_pattern.description: A pattern: the tile of a pattern definition repeated.

pattern.description: Name of the pattern (the `name` in a core.paint.pattern node; the structure node's `patterns` table says which node). A name the document does not have paints nothing.

xf.description: Maps pattern space to the document. Absent: the identity (tiles anchored at the document origin).

color.description: The colour painted. With `swatch`, the linked swatch's colour at `tint` (kept here so a reader need not resolve the link).

swatch.description: Name of the global or spot swatch (in the swatches node) the colour is linked to: editing the swatch recolours the paint. Absent: not linked.

tint.description: Tint of the linked swatch: 0 (none of it) to 1 (full strength); a spot tint prints this much of its plate. Absent: 1.

burasagari.description: Hanging punctuation. One of: `none` (none; the default when absent); `standard` (a comma or full stop that does not fit hangs outside the line); `forced` (a comma or full stop ending a line always hangs).

composer.description: How lines are broken. One of: `everyLine` (the breaks of the whole paragraph are chosen together for even spacing; the default when absent); `singleLine` (each line is broken as soon as it is full).

direction.description: The paragraph's base direction for bidirectional text (Unicode UAX #9). Absent: from its first strong character. One of: `leftToRight`; `rightToLeft`.

first_line_indent.description: Extra indent of the first line, in points (negative: a hanging indent). Absent: 0.

hyphenate.description: Words may be hyphenated at line ends. Absent: false.

justify.description: Alignment of the paragraph's lines. One of: `Left` (flush left; the default when absent); `Center` (centred); `Right` (flush right); `JustifyLeft` (justified, last line flush left); `JustifyCenter` (justified, last line centred); `JustifyRight` (justified, last line flush right); `JustifyAll` (justified, last line too).

justify_auto.description: True: aligned to the start of the paragraph's direction (left for left-to-right text, right for right-to-left); `justify` is then written as `Left` and ignored. Absent: false.

kinsoku.description: Which Japanese characters may not start or end a line. One of: `hard` (closing brackets, commas, full stops, small kana and the like do not start a line, opening brackets do not end one; the default when absent); `soft` (as hard, but iteration marks, the prolonged sound mark and small kana may start a line); `none` (no restriction).

leading_model.description: How leading is measured. One of: `romanBaseline` (from one baseline to the next; the default when absent); `emBoxTop` (from the top of one line's em box to the next's).

left_indent.description: Indent of every line from the left edge, in points. Absent: 0.

mojikumi.description: Japanese composition: the spacing of punctuation. One of: `none` (every character takes its full advance; the default when absent); `lineEndHalf` (consecutive punctuation shares one half-em space, and closing punctuation ending a line is set half width).

right_indent.description: Indent of every line from the right edge, in points. Absent: 0.

space_after.description: Space below the paragraph, in points. Absent: 0.

space_before.description: Space above the paragraph, in points. Absent: 0.

style_name.description: Name of the paragraph style (in the core.text.styles node) these attributes come from. Absent: the normal paragraph style.

tabs.description: Tab stops, by ascending position. Absent: none.

path.description: Path geometry: one or more contours, painted together under one fill rule.

placement.description: How a file read again takes the place of the art it replaces (used by the application when a link is updated).

align.description: Where the new art sits in the old bounds. One of: `center` (the default); `topLeft`; `top`; `topRight`; `left`; `right`; `bottomLeft`; `bottom`; `bottomRight`.

clip.description: True: the new art is clipped to the old bounds where it is larger. Absent: false.

preserve.description: What is kept. One of: `bounds` (the art's bounds: the new art is stretched into them; the default); `transforms` (its scale, rotation and position); `fileDimensions` (only its position: the new art at 100%, unrotated); `fit` (its bounds: the new art scaled proportionally to fit inside); `fill` (its bounds: the new art scaled proportionally to fill them).

point.description: A point in the space the field's description names, in points (1/72 inch); x grows right, y grows down.

pressure_profile.description: Pen pressure recorded along a stroke.

items.description: `[position, pressure]`: position 0 to 1 along the path's length, pressure 0 to 1.

repeat_grid.description: Copies of the source on a grid (tile = the source's bounds grown by the spacing).

flipCols.description: True: alternate columns are flipped horizontally. Absent: false.

flipRows.description: True: alternate rows are flipped vertically. Absent: false.

hSpacing.description: Horizontal gap between copies in points.

vSpacing.description: Vertical gap between copies in points.

repeat_kind.description: How a repeat places its copies.

type.description: The kind of repeat. One of: `radial` (around a centre); `grid` (on a grid); `mirror` (mirrored across an axis).

angle.description: Angle of the mirror axis in degrees (90: a vertical axis).

center.description: A point the axis passes through, document coordinates.

repeat_radial.description: Copies of the source rotated around a centre.

endAngle.description: Angle at which the copies end, in degrees. Absent: 360.

instances.description: Number of copies, the source included.

radius.description: Distance of the source's centre from `center`, in points.

reverseOverlap.description: True: later copies paint below earlier ones. Absent: false.

startAngle.description: Angle of the first copy in degrees. Absent: 0.

stroke_item.description: A stroke: the object's outline painted.

align.description: Where the stroke lies relative to a closed path. One of: `Center` (half on each side; the default when absent); `Inside` (entirely inside the shape); `Outside` (entirely outside the shape).

arrow_align.description: Where an arrowhead sits. One of: `Extend` (its tip extends past the path's end point; the default when absent); `Tip` (its tip sits on the end point).

arrow_scale.description: Size of the start and end arrowheads, in percent of their natural size at this stroke width: `[start, end]`. Absent: `[100, 100]`.

blend.description: Blend mode of this fill or stroke alone. Absent: `Normal`.

brush.description: Name of the brush applied to the stroke (defined in the x.vectorcraft.brushes node). A reader without that node, or without the name, draws the plain stroke. Absent: no brush.

cap.description: The shape of the stroke's open ends. One of: `Butt` (cut square at the end point; the default when absent); `Round` (a semicircle of diameter `width`); `Square` (a square extending half the width past the end point).

dash.description: The dash pattern. Absent: a solid line.

effects.description: Live effects applied to this fill or stroke alone, in order. Absent: none.

end_arrow.description: Arrowhead at the path's end. Absent: none.

gradient_mode.description: How a gradient paint maps onto the stroke. One of: `Within` (placed on the page like a fill's gradient and seen through the stroke; the default when absent); `Along` (from the start of each contour to its end, following the path); `Across` (from the stroke's left edge to its right edge, all along it).

join.description: The shape of the stroke's corners. One of: `Miter` (extended to a point while within `miter_limit`, else bevelled; the default when absent); `Round` (rounded with radius half the width); `Bevel` (cut straight across).

miter_limit.description: The largest ratio of miter length to stroke width a `Miter` join may have before it is bevelled (as in SVG and PDF). Absent: 10.

opacity.description: Opacity of this fill or stroke alone, 0 to 1. Absent: 1.

overprint.description: True: on press, the inks of this fill or stroke print over the inks below instead of knocking them out. Absent: false.

paint.description: What the stroke is painted with.

pressure.description: The pen pressure the stroke was drawn with; pressure-sensitive brushes vary with it. Absent: none.

profile.description: A variable-width profile. Absent: uniform width.

start_arrow.description: Arrowhead at the path's start. Absent: none.

visible.description: False: kept but not painted. Absent: true.

subpath.description: One contour: its anchors in order. The segment from anchor i to anchor i+1 is the cubic Bezier (p_i, out_i, in_{i+1}, p_{i+1}); a closed contour also has the segment from the last anchor back to the first.

anchors.description: The anchors, in drawing order. May be empty.

closed.description: True: the contour is closed (last anchor joined to the first). Absent: false.

align.description: How text after the tab aligns to the stop. One of: `left` (starts at the stop; the default when absent); `center` (is centred on it); `right` (ends at it); `decimal` (aligns its first `alignOn` character on it).

alignOn.description: Decimal tabs align on this character (one character). Absent: `.`.

leader.description: Characters repeated across the tab's gap (for example `. `). Absent: none.

position.description: Distance from the frame's left edge in points.

kind.description: The kind of type. One of: `point` (point type); `area` (area type in a frame); `onpath` (type on a path).

text_kind_area.description: Area type: text flowed inside a frame.

frame.description: The frame's outline, in text space.

text_kind_onpath.description: Type on a path: the baseline follows a path.

end.description: Where the text ends, as a fraction of the path's length. Absent: the end of the path (once round, for a closed path).

start.description: Where the text starts, as a fraction 0 to 1 of the path's length.

text_kind_point.description: Point type: lines start at the origin of text space and run until a line break.

text_run.description: A run of characters with one set of character attributes.

inline.description: The run is an inline graphic. Absent: ordinary characters.

text.description: The characters. U+000A ends a paragraph; U+0009 is a tab.

invert.description: True: text flows inside the object instead of around it. Absent: false.

offset.description: Distance kept between the text and the object, in points. Absent: 6.
brickByRow and brickByColumn only: the shift, as a fraction of the tile. Absent: 0.5.

type.description: The arrangement. One of: `grid` (rows and columns); `brickByRow` (each row shifted horizontally by `offset` tile widths against the one above); `brickByColumn` (each column shifted vertically by `offset` tile heights); `hexByColumn` (hexagonal tiles in columns 3/4 of a tile width apart, odd columns shifted half a tile down); `hexByRow` (hexagonal tiles in rows 3/4 of a tile height apart, odd rows shifted half a tile right).

vec2.description: A displacement: the same units and axes as a point.

width_profile.description: A variable-width profile of a stroke.

points.description: The profile's points by ascending position; widths are linear between them. Two points at one position make a step: the first is the width just before it, the second just after.

items.description: `[position, left, right]`: `position` 0 (start) to 1 (end) along the path's length; `left` and `right` are factors of half the stroke width on the left and right of the path's direction.

wrap_shape.description: A shape area type flows around: the outline of a wrap object above the type, in text space. Derived from the document's wrap objects by the application each time they change; a reader may recompute it.

invert.description: True: text flows inside the outline. Absent: false.

offset.description: Distance kept from the outline, in points. Absent: 6.

description: A graph design: named art that VectorCraft's graphs draw in place of their default columns and markers. Only VectorCraft's graph generator uses it; the marks a graph drew are ordinary objects in its layer.

name.description: The design's name: what a graph's `seriesMarkers` name it by.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

title: x.vectorcraft.graph-design - art a VectorCraft graph draws its marks with
